note: Thin app pages: noindex, follow and left out of the sitemap. A generated tutorial that points its canonical at one of these is noindexed too. Add real content (data/enrichment.json or data/app-extras.json) and remove the name here to index it again.
rule: A page counts as thin when all of these hold: (1) it is generated only from package database facts, with no reviewed description, no screenshot, no demo video and no hand written FAQ; (2) the app has no hand written guide; (3) the package was added to the repo more than 30 days ago; (4) Search Console page data for the last 60 days (Sep 3 to Nov 1, 2026 PT, web search) shows no clicks and under 30 impressions. Hand guides, the homepage, leaderboard, press and flea, strata, slap-notes-bin and omarchy-task-manager are never listed.
